caveats: All 269 directly re-read from raw major_rights ledger and confirmed absent from actual event field; key set, status and route lists match prior audit.

No decision-time cash or actual trip charge is recorded in these right rows. Null is unknown, not zero. Career net_at_decision is NOT a cash balance.
Harper modeled costs are separate prior source-based estimates, not recorded charges. No costs inferred for other cases.
Conditional right_state is retained faithfully; otherwise-eligible synthetic tests must satisfy the amateur condition, not blindly convert historical conditional records to earned.
Synthetic cash=0 is a test input only; it is not a claim about historical finances.
Harper has 8 total declines: two in2047 plus the six previously analyzed in2048–2050. The modeled-cost subset is6, not the total Harper case count.
